paragraphs: AI-assisted field safety paperwork. Workers describe a task by voice or text and the app cross-references it against the company's uploaded SOPs to generate hazards, controls, required PPE, and compliance alerts — alongside seven other document types (equipment inspections, toolbox talks, near miss/incident reports, daily reports, monthly site inspections, and custom documents). Multi-tenant: every company's data, forms, and users are isolated from every other company's.

requirements.text: Company-code login — nobody types a shared password.

Too many wrong PINs locks a person for 15 minutes; their supervisor or the Account Owner can unlock them from the Roster, and a locked Account Owner can email themselves an unlock link from the login screen.
Stripe anchors the billing cycle to the moment the subscription is created, which is the "monthly from signup date" behaviour, so no billingcycleanchor is set.
